faq.question: Is root canal treatment really painless?
faq.answer: Yes — we use modern rotary endodontics and local anesthesia, so most patients feel little to no pain during the procedure. Many are completed in a single sitting.

faq.question: Do you treat children?
faq.answer: Yes, our team offers gentle, friendly pediatric dentistry designed to make young patients comfortable from their very first visit.

faq.question: What are your clinic hours?
faq.answer: We're open Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. We're closed on Sundays.

faq.question: Do I need an appointment, or can I walk in?
faq.answer: We recommend booking an appointment online or by phone/WhatsApp so we can minimize your wait time, but walk-ins are welcome based on availability.
